Read [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md) and the [testing standard](../../.agent/standards/testing.md). Use the [defect workflow](../../.agent/workflows/defect-investigation.md) for regression investigation.

There are currently no automated test projects. Follow the build and demo validation guidance in [DEVELOPING.md](../../DEVELOPING.md#environment-and-commands), and update that document and these globs when adding a test suite.
